caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile or rug featuring various abstract and representational shapes. Prominently, at the center are two animal figures, possibly oxen or horses, facing each other; they are rendered in light gray with red, blue, and black outlining. Above the animals are two large red, circular wagon wheels, and a partially visible structure with red rectangles that could represent a cart or building. On the left side, a red hand with five fingers is reaching towards the animals. The background is filled with irregular patches of brown, green, beige, and black, forming a mosaic-like composition. Red maple leaves are seen in three corners (top left, bottom left, and bottom right). There is a vertical band of writing along the right margin that appears to read "LAND ADIRE" and "1841". The dominant colors in the composition are brown, red, gray, black, green, and some blue accents. The entire composition is bordered by a thin, dark outline.
title: Hooked Rug
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
